title: THE PIXEL DOOR AND WINDOW
why: Job 86d ship 3: the door (frame, panels, lock plate and tag), the window, the stronghold shutter and barricade and the Undercroft wall are filled on the 2 unit art grid with solid district ramp and ink tones, instead of translucent vector rects. Kerbs and ruins already bake through the pixel wall sprite.
now: With the pixel look on (the default), doors, windows, stronghold gates and barricades and the Undercroft walls are chunky solid pixels like the walls. With the look off, nothing changes.
